remarks: Built in 2007, this spacious 3BR, 2.5BA luxury townhouse delivers exceptional functionality across four levels in a quiet 4-unit complex. This rear corner, last-available unit is tucked away on a peaceful street and offers over 2,600 sq ft with optional finished space. The main level features a welcoming foyer, eat-in kitchen with granite counters and breakfast nook, and an oversized living/dining room with beautiful hardwood floors extending throughout the main and top levels. French doors open to a private bluestone patio with stone fireplace. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a walk-in closet and spa-like bath, along with two additional bedrooms and a second full bath. A vaulted top-floor family room provides flexible space for office, gym, media, or guests. The lower level offers 9-ft ceilings and finishing potential. Zoned HVAC, attached 2-car garage, and dedicated parking. Less than one mile to the Rowayton train and minutes to Rowayton village, vibrant SONO, Oak Hills Golf Course, Calf Pasture Beach, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes.
